hotspots.body: The central hub of this concept. It holds the home view and the task queue. It sends no commands in this demo; everything shown is illustrative.
hotspots.title: HERMES-TV console

hotspots.body: A connected display in this concept. Displayed as a device role only; no platform is shown as tested, connected, or supported.
hotspots.title: Television (concept)

hotspots.body: A household computer in this concept. Device roles are conceptual unless supported by verified implementation evidence.
hotspots.title: Desktop (concept)

hotspots.body: A portable display in this concept. Nothing here pairs, scans, or controls a real device.
hotspots.title: Tablet (concept)

hotspots.body: A personal device in this concept. No credentials are requested and no session is opened.
hotspots.title: Phone (concept)

hotspots.body: A home hub in this concept. Its glow marks the role, not a live connection.
hotspots.title: Smart home hub (concept)

hotspots.body: The bridge is the pairing and permission boundary in the HERMES-TV architecture: authenticated pairing, no credentials embedded in the television. Shown here as architecture, not as a live session.
hotspots.title: Secure bridge (concept)

hotspots.body: The Utility Grid is the shared metering and governance layer in AGENTROPOLIS. This hero shows it as a concept only; no usage, metering, or billing is represented.
hotspots.title: Utility Grid (concept)

hotspots.body: HERMES-TV is device-, protocol-, and runtime-agnostic by design. Hermes is an initial integration, not the only possible runtime. No single vendor, agent runtime, or TV operating system is hard-coded into this scene.
hotspots.title: Runtime independence

note: Procedural scene data for the HERMES-TV hero. No panorama, depth map, or model was recovered from a source image: the reference panorama named in the directive did not arrive with it, so this composition follows the directive's written description. Rear views and unseen surroundings are artistic extensions, not recovered details.
